name: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each TB lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 885340-08-9, formula C38H68N10O14, 889 Da).

faq.question: How should TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment) be stored?
faq.answer: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment) ships lyophilized and should stay at −20 °C until reconstitution; after that keep it at 2–8 °C and avoid freeze–thaw cycles.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment)?
faq.answer: TB-500 (Thymosin Beta-4 Fragment) is stocked in 3 pack sizes (2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $45.62; 10–49 kits falls to $41.98 (−8%) and 50+ to $38.78 (−15%).
